title: Epic Skin Pak Of Doom!
description: a pack for Legacy Skins. All skins were made by me.
body:
This is a Skin Pack for [Legacy4J](https://modrinth.com/mod/legacy4j). Adds 10 skins:
- Ryan Patel (Jumpcut)
- Trevor Carmichael (Jumpcut)
- Jasper Fischer (Jumpcut)
- Gilbert Kendrick (Jumpcut)
- Ashton Trueman (Jumpcut)
- Jason Voorhees (Friday The 13th)
- 1x1x1x1 (ROBLOX)
- Shedletsky (ROBLOX)
- Max (Sam & Max)
- Strong Bad (Homestar Runner)
